name: SADIST MINTALITY
source:
Yandere Slop Visual Novel. He hits you with his car, takes you home and does gorey stuff to you. Can be read as either a Survive Min AU or a Prequel before he died.

[From [url=https://yanwatchesyou.itch.io/mintality]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部病娇快餐系视觉小说：他开车撞倒了你，把你带回家中，对你施以种种血腥猎奇的折磨。本作既可当作角色“明”存活下来的平行世界线（IF线）阅读，也可当作他死前的前传故事。

[摘自[url=https://yanwatchesyou.itch.io/mintality]Itch.io[/url]]
